title: Fellowships · Resources · Bible Guide
heading: Fellowships around the Word, together
paragraph: National fellowships that gather believers to pray and to study the word together, across the country and online. Each says who it is for, how it meets and what it costs, and has its own group finder. In Jacksonville, Miami, Orlando, Atlanta and Charlotte, a map shows the groups and churches those finders list, street by street.

blocks.text: National fellowships that gather believers to pray and to study the word together, across the country and online. Each says who it is for, how it meets and what it costs, and has its own group finder. In Jacksonville, Miami, Orlando, Atlanta and Charlotte, a map shows the groups and churches those finders list, street by street.
“And they continued stedfastly in the apostles’ doctrine and fellowship, and in breaking of bread, and in prayers.”Acts 2:42
Who are you looking for a group for? Each number counts the fellowships open to them, including those open to anyone. Then pick a kind of fellowship on the left; every row has its group finder ready.

The BSF Study runs 30 weeks: daily questions on your own, a weekly small-group discussion, teaching from a trained leader and lesson notes. Groups meet in person or online, and the WordGo app lets friends study at their own pace.
In person, Online, On your own
Free (BSF calls its study free and open to all)

BSF's group finder listed 26 groups around Jacksonville on 2026-10-08 (6 men's, 20 women's; in person and online), for example at Mandarin Baptist Church, Westside Baptist Church and Christian Family Chapel.
Classes are coed, men's or women's, and many offer children's groups.
Each class sets a registration fee. CBS says giving is voluntary, people who cannot contribute may attend freely, and registration scholarships are always available.
The class finder (ZIP 32202) listed Jacksonville South FL classes (Main and Saint Johns), plus Fleming Island, Callahan and Amelia Island, on 2026-10-08.
Groups use the Precept inductive Bible study method, led by trained discussion leaders, in person or online; you can also study on your own.
In person, Online, On your own
No group fee is stated on its pages; members use a study workbook, sold in Precept's shop, and the first lesson of each study can be downloaded free. Some groups list extra fees on their own page.

The group finder (within 100 miles of ZIP 32202) listed 8 in-person groups on 2026-10-08. The nearest was in Fernandina Beach; the others were in Gainesville, Daytona Beach and The Villages. None was in Jacksonville itself.
It offers small-group Bible studies, Women's Connection gatherings and prayer groups, locally in person and online (including weekly prayer calls on Zoom).
No group fee is stated. Stonecroft Bible Study guides are sold in its shop (for example, Aware cost $8.99 on 2026-10-08).
The group locator (35-mile radius) listed one group on 2026-10-08: Orange Park FL Women's Connection, about 12 miles away.
Women can study alone, in online groups (Facebook or Instagram, email or text) or in groups of about 4 to 12 that meet in homes or churches; groups regroup each season.
In person, Online, On your own
Not stated on the page checked. The site sells printed and digital study journals and offers a free printable habit tracker to email subscribers.

Precept Ministries International: Founded by Kay and Jack Arthur in 1970 to engage people in relationship with God through knowing His Word. Groups use the Precept inductive Bible study method, led by trained discussion leaders, in person or online; you can also study on your own.
Hours: Wednesdays 6:00-7:00 PM (this study runs to 2026-11-11)

The Navigators: A Christian ministry that shares the gospel of Jesus and helps people grow in Christ through Life-to-Life discipleship. It describes this as a commitment to walk with friends rather than a programme. Its ministries include college campuses (with one-on-one Bible studies), the military, workplaces and churches. A free email series, Digital Discipleship Journeys, is available online.
